text:
erin_buyer: Vendor pulled us in - factory knock-on. They propose three handles: expedited air for 12 new units (5d, premium), a tranche of 18 refurbished loaners on next flight (2d), or bulk sea for remaining (20d). They also offered a 5% credit if we accept loaners and later convert some to buys. Need quick ops + finance call.

hao_ops: Current APAC pool is running 90% util on weekdays. Losing 18 immediately would start queuing low-priority tenant jobs. We should consider routing low-priority batch to eu-west for a short window rather than choke canaries.

jeremy_sre: If we accept loaners we require strict parity checks: firmware match, per-GPU thermal slope within 12% of baseline, and a 72h burn-in capturing ECC and perf counters. Any failing unit -> RMA pickup within 96h. We need vendor pickup labels pre-issued.

lina_log: Customs: several APAC countries accept ATA carnet for temporary import which speeds clearance but needs serial ranges and consignee signatures. If we get manifests now we can pre-file carnet docs and avoid the 24-48h soft hold. Otherwise expect hold.

vendor_zen: Loaners are SAN-graded, cleaned, and flow-tested. Deposit requested at 2.5% refundable. We can supply manifests and photos within 3 hours and provide return AWB labels. Premium air surcharge = $2,500/unit. We will draft an addendum with RMA pickup SLA.

finance_bot: Quick math: assume price $46k/unit. Deposit 2.5% = $1,150/unit. For 18 loaners that's $20,700. Air premium for 12 new = 12 * 2500 = $30k. If converted later, 5% credit off purchase price for those converted units.

erin_buyer: Procurement asks: escrow via ClearEscrow preferred so Redwood doesn't book large liability. Also need vendor to explicitly accept carve-out that loaners cannot be used for customer-dedicated guaranteed pools unless addendum signed.

vendor_zen: We can use ClearEscrow. We'll include clause: loaners will not be certified for committed Dedicated tenancy until conversion and full test pass.

jeremy_sre: Operational checklist for loaners on arrival: 1) run parity and burn-in job (72h) 2) collect thermal & ECC logs 3) automated firmware audit 4) sample model regression (10k tokens). If any check fails, mark unit for RMA.

lina_log: Proposed split to minimize exposure: 12 new air (5d), 18 loaners (2d), 20 sea (20d). That staggers customs and reduces immediate deposit. Need serial ranges to pre-file ATA carnet.

vendor_zen: Manifest sample: AWB: ZEN-990011
LOANERS: A800-L-5001..A800-L-5018
NEW: A800-N-2201..A800-N-2212
SEA: A800-S-7001..A800-S-7020
HS: 8471.80.10
Addendum: deposit 2.5% refundable within 14 days of receipt & inspection of returns; vendor covers RMA pickup if unit fails acceptance.

finance_bot: Escrow flow OK. Accounting: treat deposit as restricted cash/liability until resolved. I'll open a payments ticket to set ClearEscrow.

erin_buyer: Decision: approve conditional split (12 air / 18 loaners / 20 sea) pending signed addendum, ClearEscrow setup, and jeremy_sre parity scripts integrated into depot job. Vendor must upload manifest by EOD local time.

customs_bot: Pre-file request created (TKT-AP-558). Will start carnet prep once serials received.

lina_log: I'll coordinate crossdock slots and hold the canary rollouts until burn-in flags green.

vendor_zen: Uploading manifest & drafting addendum now.

erin_buyer: Thanks all. We'll reconvene if vendor changes terms. (reactions: :white_check_mark: from jeremy_sre, :eyes: from vendor_zen)
